senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unknown, obscure, not famous or notorious.
E.
अ neg. ख्यात famed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Said, spoken.
2 Called, declared.
3 Made known.
4 Inflected, declined, conjugated.
E.
part. past. of आख्या to say, to speak, &c.

f. (-तिः)
Disrepute, want of fame.
E.
अ neg. ख्याति fame.

f. (-ख्या)
A name or appellation.
E.
ख्या to say, आङ् prefixed, अङ् and टाप् fem. aff.

n. (-नं)
1 A tale, a legend.
2 Saying, declaring.
E.
आङ् before ख्या to tell, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-कः)
A messenger, a teller, an announcer or relater.
f. (-यिका)
A tale, a true or probable story.
E.
आख्या to say, ण्वुल् affix, यत्; inserted.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fit or proper to be said.
E.
आङ् before ख्या to say, affix यत्; also आख्यातब्य.
